issues.problem: The 'warning instead of a silent default' is not complete. (a) Without a TOML parser, string_values decodes basic strings with json.loads instead of the module's own TOML lexer (_Lexer.basic_string): a \UXXXXXXXX escape or a literal tab (both valid TOML 1.0) is dropped silently, and the inline-table form alo-labs-codex = { source_type = ..., source = ... } (read fine with a parser) is not read; all three fall back to ~/.codex/.tmp/marketplaces/alo-labs-codex with no warning. (b) With a parser, the narrowed except no longer covers a non-table value: [marketplaces] alo-labs-codex = "x" or marketplaces = 3 now prints a Python traceback (AttributeError) instead of the WARN (the old code fell back silently).
issues.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-silver-bullet/a8e36ab4-d9e2-56b2-b366-31e100f031d9/scratchpad/review/REVF-H2fu-probe/noparser/run.sh harness (shadowed tomllib/tomli/pip): [inline/noparser] out=alo-labs-codex (parser: 'plain dir'); [Uescape/noparser] source="<D>/emoji\U0001F600dir" -> default root (parser: emoji😀dir); [literaltab/noparser] -> default root (parser: 'tab<TAB>dir'); all with empty stderr. [nondict/parser] -> 'Traceback ... AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'get'' then default root.
issues.suggested_fix: Decode with the lexer (e.g. _Lexer(text, label).basic_string(i) for basic strings), read an inline-table value through the lexer too (or warn when the alo-labs-codex key exists but yields no source), and treat a non-dict table as 'cannot read' (isinstance checks, or catch AttributeError/TypeError) so it prints the WARN.
